### The Colombian economy   at a glance

Microsoft Power BI

![Power BI loading](https://content.powerapps.com/resource/powerbiwfe/images/spinner-PBI-logo.150b66cb3782a15fdd41.svg)

[Microsoft Power BI](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=722383&clcid=0x409)

[Flag this content as inappropriate](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-bi/support/service-support-options#how-do-i-contact-support "Flag this content as inappropriate")

###### The seedbed

We provide society with comprehensive analyses of the country's economy and reliable projections of its future evolution, serving as a reference for decision-making. We produce semi-annual, special, and weekly reports, which are presented in partnership with various institutions and media outlets, as input for the decision-making of economic agents.

###### Lines of research

Monetary policy and inflation.

Fiscal policy.

Balance of payments.

Finance.

Labor Market.

Global Economy.

Nowcasting.

###### Examples of questions answered in the seedbed

How are economic dynamics evolving in response to current events in society? What is the role of economic policy in the functioning of countries and in mitigating crises? How do global economic events impact the stability of developed and developing countries?

###### This Seedbed is for you if...

If you are interested in current economic and political affairs, enjoy working with data, and want to learn about the workings of the Colombian economy from the most experienced professors.

###### Main activities

Weekly Meetings of the Economic Outlook Seedbed.

Preparation of the semi-annual economic situation report with the EAFIT Public Value Center.

Organization and development of the Economic Perspectives Forum in partnership with the Medellín Chamber of Commerce and El Colombiano newspaper.

Development of Macroeconomic Indicators in Power BI.

Economy
